$description: The sizes the board's own furniture is cut to — widths, heights, hit targets and offsets.

source.reason: a column's width is a product decision about how much of a card is readable at a glance; Obsidian has no variable for it.
how narrow a popover may shrink; Obsidian's own menus are sized by their content, not by a published variable.
how wide a popover may grow to fit its longest label; Obsidian publishes no popover width.
the column popover's fixed width, chosen for its swatch grid; Obsidian publishes no popover width.
how tall a popover may grow before it scrolls; Obsidian publishes no popover height.
the edit-column dialog's width; Obsidian's modal variables are a later phase (audit 02-34).
the column popover's inside padding, off Obsidian's 4px grid; the later phase that adopts the grid is what removes it.
the side panel's width before CardDetail sets the user's own inline; a user preference has no host variable.
the detail panel's width when it opens as a dialog instead; Obsidian's modal variables are a later phase (audit 02-34).
the share of the viewport the dialog may take on a narrow window; a viewport fraction is not something Obsidian names.
the share of the viewport height the dialog may take; a viewport fraction is not something Obsidian names.
how far the panel travels as it opens — a motion distance, not a layout size.
how tall the filter suggestions may grow before they scroll; Obsidian publishes no suggestion-list height.
the search box's preferred width in the toolbar; Obsidian publishes no search-input width.
the add-column placeholder is deliberately narrower than a real column.
the fixed column the property keys line up in, chosen so the values align; Obsidian's property editor is a later phase (audit 02-41).
the room a card's title leaves for the hover actions that sit over it.
how much narrower the lifted drag copy is than the column it came from.
what the rendered description leaves of the viewport for everything above and below it; CardDetail measures the real figure and writes it live.
the viewport itself, which nothing in a theme can name; the caps measured against it read it from here.
the viewport itself, which nothing in a theme can name; the caps measured against it read it from here.
how far a parked column slides out of the row, leaving a strip of it on screen; a product behaviour with no host equivalent.
how far above the board's bottom edge the completion toast floats.
the height of the board's own inline controls; Obsidian's --input-height is the variable this becomes when per-control variables are adopted (audit 02-15).
the horizontal padding inside those controls, off Obsidian's 4px grid.
the icon buttons' hit target, off Obsidian's 4px grid; sizing them from --input-height or the icon scale is a later phase (audit 02-14, 02-15).
the checkbox-like marker in a card's next-todo preview, off Obsidian's 4px grid; Obsidian's checkbox geometry is a later phase (audit 02-35).
a one-pixel rule drawn as a filled element rather than a border, so the border width does not describe it.
pulls the resize handle half outside the panel so it straddles the edge; Obsidian's own divider is a later phase (audit 02-17).
how far an inline icon drops below the text baseline, measured in that text; a typographic correction Obsidian does not publish.
how far the context strip sits past the priority bar so it never draws on top of it; the number answers to border.cue-thickness, not to the spacing rhythm.
